claim_title: Blue light glasses improve sleep quality
caption: **Blue light glasses and sleep.** The evidence here is thin: one reviewed paper only summarizes other studies without combining their data, and its authors found no clear effect on sleep. Another was a pilot trial with just 14 participants where the sleep benefit did not survive statistical correction and objective measures barely moved. There isn't enough solid evidence to confirm the claim.
subtitle: The reviewed studies are too small or unpooled to confirm any sleep benefit.
